pressure.title: Differential pressure
pressure.description: Differential pressure in inches of water column (in. WC). Type byte 0x00 in SD-0178. Unit from the SD-0178 offset command table.

gaugeDiffPressure.title: Gauge or differential pressure
gaugeDiffPressure.description: Gauge or wet/wet differential pressure in PSI. Type byte 0x13 in SD-0178. Unit from the SD-0178 offset command table.

humidity.title: Humidity
humidity.description: Relative humidity in %. Type byte 0x02 in SD-0178.

temperature.title: Temperature °C
temperature.description: Temperature from the humidity and temperature sensor, converted to °C. The sensor sends this value in °F (type byte 0x01 in SD-0178).

temperatureF.title: Temperature °F
temperatureF.description: Temperature from the humidity and temperature sensor in °F, as sent by the sensor. Type byte 0x01 in SD-0178.

probeTemperature.title: Probe temperature °C
probeTemperature.description: Temperature from the thermistor probe input, converted to °C. The sensor sends this value in °F (type byte 0x08 in SD-0178).

probeTemperatureF.title: Probe temperature °F
probeTemperatureF.description: Temperature from the thermistor probe input in °F, as sent by the sensor. Type byte 0x08 in SD-0178.

voltage.title: Analog voltage input
voltage.description: Analog input voltage in V DC. Type byte 0x06 in SD-0178.

current.title: Analog current input
current.description: Analog input current of the 4-20 mA input, in mA. Type byte 0x07 in SD-0178.

contact.title: Contact state
contact.description: State of the dry contact input. Type byte 0x04 in SD-0178. 0 is open and 1 is closed. A closed contact triggers a transmission.
